nativeRoute: Audience Project Personal key (not browser session / service provider key)

loginFlow.steps: 复用 AUDIENCE_SYNC_API_KEY 或多别名 AUDIENCE_SYNC_API_KEYS；只读验证每把用户已提供 key 的 Project 与允许操作。缺少/无效 key 仅返回原生 Audience 入口，由用户在应用内申请 Project Personal key。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Bearer Project Personal key；不能用 Brevo/Athena/平台服务 secret 替代；别名不是权限证据。
subjectPermission: GET /api/platform/v3/personal-key（get_project_personal_key_context），然后目标 Project capabilities；Project 匹配、owner scope、allowed operations 按返回值。
expiryRevoke: key expiry/revoke UI 与服务端实现未在发布契约中说明；需平台 owner 提供 key 生命周期/撤销回读，失效时返回入口不循环重试。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
